title: FACT: A Forensic Agent with Compiled Tool-Use Trajectories for AI-Generated Image Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.05876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-generated image detection is increasingly open-world: new image generators produce highly realistic images that make visual artifacts harder to identify. Existing detectors usually rely on a fixed set of forensic cues, so a detector that works well for one generator family may fail on another. We introduce FACT (Forensic Agent with Compiled Tool-use Trajectories), which learns an image-conditioned tool-use policy for forensic analysis. Instead of applying a fixed detector, FACT decides which forensic tools to call, interprets the returned evidence, and stops when sufficient evidence has been collected. FACT follows an Evolve--Distill--Refine pipeline: it evolves an execution-verified forensic skill, compiles the skill into action--observation tool-use trajectories, distills them into a compact agent, and refines the policy with cost-aware GRPO. translated_title: FACT：一种基于编译工具使用轨迹的AI生成图像检测取证智能体
translated_abstract: AI生成图像检测正日益面临开放世界的挑战：新的图像生成器能够生成高度逼真的图像，使视觉伪迹更难识别。现有检测器通常依赖一组固定的取证线索，因此对某一类生成器效果良好的检测器在其他生成器上可能失效。我们提出了FACT（具有编译工具使用轨迹的取证智能体），它学习一种以图像为条件的工具使用策略来执行取证分析。FACT不采用固定的检测器，而是自主决定调用哪些取证工具、解读返回的证据，并在收集到足够证据后停止。FACT遵循“进化—蒸馏—精炼”的流水线：它进化出经过执行验证的取证技能，将该技能编译为动作—观察形式的工具使用轨迹，将其蒸馏为一个紧凑的智能体，并通过成本感知的GRPO对策略进行精炼。在两个内部基准和四个公开基准上，FACT在所有对比方法中取得了最佳性能。
tldr: FACT提出了一种学习图像条件工具使用策略的取证智能体，通过“进化—蒸馏—精炼”流水线动态调用和解读取证工具，实现了跨多种生成器的最先进AI生成图像检测。
en_tdlr: FACT is a forensic agent that learns an image-conditioned tool-use policy through an Evolve-Distill-Refine pipeline, dynamically selecting and interpreting forensic tools to achieve state-of-the-art AI-generated image detection across diverse generators.
